dayView.description: What the account did on one day.

pushes.description: Refs it moved, made or deleted, one for each claim.

main.description: How much an account did on each day since a time, by kind, as an appview has indexed it, and its repositories' pushes: when each was last pushed to, and how often on each of those days. Days are dates in the zone `tz`, and only days with something done are listed. Repositories and accounts taken down count for nothing. No authentication needed; asked with a service token or the pages' session cookie by the account itself, or by a member of its private repositories, those it may read are among `repos` too, and the answer is the asker's alone.

repos.description: Each of the account's repositories ever pushed to, by name.

since.description: The first day counted is the one this falls on in `tz`; a year before now if not given.

tz.description: The IANA time zone whose days are counted, as `America/New_York`; UTC if not given or not known.

repoActivity.description: The pushes to one of the account's repositories.

days.description: The days since `since` it was pushed to, oldest first.

name.description: The repository's name: its record key.

pushedAt.description: When it was last pushed to, ever.

repoDay.description: The pushes to a repository on one day.

description: How much an account did on each day, as an appview has indexed it.
